summary: Bounded current-main Physics Lab geometry mining found no new practical non-duplicate authored-geometry leaf after live lane archaeology. Office-chair caster/ground/base contact plus mass/COM, rolling-cart caster/contact plus mass/COM, rolling-cart shelf/frame load-path manufacturability, and office-table/filing-cabinet component-derived COM all already have dedicated lanes with deterministic source acceptance criteria. No fifth speculative geometry lane was created.
evidence: HG-PHYSICS-CHAIR-GEOMETRY already owns five-caster ground/base contact, component-mass closure, and component-derived office-chair COM with explicit family versioning.

HG-PHYSICS-CART-GEOMETRY already owns four-caster ground/chassis contact and rolling-cart component-derived COM; HG-PHYSICS-CART-SHELF-FRAME separately owns the remaining shelf/upright load-path manufacturability debt.

HG-PHYSICS-TABLE-CABINET-COM already records the source-only component-mass-weighted COM inconsistency for the office-table and filing-cabinet fixtures with exact target centroids and deterministic regression requirements.

These lanes intentionally remain blocked/proposed behind integration/trusted-control sequencing; duplicating them through capacity mining would increase WIP without adding a distinct reproducible physical invariant.
